name: Identity and Anatomy Lock
prompt: Keep the identity, face, body proportions, anatomy, skin tone, and defining features of <Subject 1> unchanged in every frame.

name: Pose and Limb Lock
prompt: Preserve the intended pose and limb relationships with stable joints, hands, fingers, feet, and contact points throughout the motion.

name: Wardrobe and Hair Lock
prompt: Keep all clothing, accessories, hair length, hairstyle, materials, colours, seams, and fastenings consistent throughout the shot.

name: Full Continuity Lock
prompt: Maintain strict identity, anatomy, wardrobe, hair, environment, lighting, camera, prop, and motion continuity from the first frame to the last.

name: Reference Fidelity Lock
prompt: Prioritise faithful use of the supplied references and do not invent, merge, swap, or omit referenced subjects, garments, props, or scene elements.

name: Clean Hands and Face
prompt: Keep the face, eyes, mouth, teeth, hands, and fingers clear and anatomically stable, especially during motion and partial occlusion.

name: Background Geometry Lock
prompt: Keep architecture, furniture, horizon lines, floor contact, reflections, and background objects spatially stable as the subject or camera moves.

name: Motion Coherence
prompt: Use physically coherent motion with natural timing, stable momentum, clean contact, and no teleporting, morphing, repeated limbs, or frame-to-frame jitter.
